cases.label: three-letter-only
cases.note: crontab(5) specifies exactly three letters; longer names are a parse error.

cases.label: prefix-tolerant
cases.note: Engines that match on a case-insensitive prefix accept the full name.

normative_evidence.quote: Names can also be used for the 'month' and 'day of week' fields. Use the first three letters of the particular day or month (case does not matter).

rationale: Tolerance beyond the grammar is itself a divergence: an expression that parses in one engine is a deployment failure in another.
title: Full weekday name (not in any published grammar)
